sections.h2: 1. Check the plug for your laptop first
parts: The 330W and 240W chargers power gaming laptops through a DC plug (XT60 on the 330W, DC5525 on the 240W) and also have USB-C ports. SlimQ sells DC converters for other laptops separately. Buying the right converter the first time matters, because SlimQ doesn't refund shipping on returns and sale items can't be returned.
Orders over $60 ship free to the US, Hong Kong and Singapore. A 65W charger at $34.99 doesn't reach it, but adding a cable or a second charger can.

sections.h2: 3. Consider the sale price before the code

SlimQ batch-ships orders twice a week and ships worldwide except a few restricted countries. International orders may owe import taxes or duties.
